subject: Ingest backpressure causing pilot stall — request for sandbox top-up & extension
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@finlytics.io>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Reddy <priya@finlytics.io>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot blocked by ingestion backpressure — need extra sandbox + 2-week extension

Hi Marissa,

Quick note from our eng team — during the nightly sync the FinLytics ingestion adapter hit sustained backpressure when streaming compressed batches into the VPC connector. The adapter retries exhausted our sandbox token budget and the pipeline got throttled; engineers had to triage and revert to a smaller batch size.

We are still committed to the pilot but this means:
- We need an extra 150k tokens for the sandbox to get through the retry window and a couple of full end-to-end runs.
- An additional two-week extension on the trial window so we can validate the fix and rerun the evaluation.

I attached ingest logs and a short config snapshot. Can Redwood approve a top-up and extend the pilot window? We can share a short post-mortem once engineering confirms the fix.

Thanks — appreciate any flexibility here.

Samir Patel
Head of Integrations, FinLytics
samir@finlytics.io
Attachment: ingest-logs.zip (6 files; 2.3MB)
Attachment: snapshot-config.json

---
FinLytics internal: Priya Reddy is on the ticket and will follow up with the deployment details.

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@finlytics.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 11:03:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot blocked by ingestion backpressure — need extra sandbox + 2-week extension

Samir — thanks for the heads up and for sending the logs.

Short answer: we can provide an interim token top-up and a two-week extension while engineering assesses the root cause. Before I commit to the full top-up, David can you take a look at the logs Samir attached and confirm whether this is a load-pattern issue we can mitigate via temporary throttling/profile change, or if we should route to Dedicated preview?

Proposed interim plan (subject to engineering):
1) Grant a one-time 100k token sandbox top-up today so their pipeline can finish the reruns.
2) Place a 14-day extension on the pilot (no billing changes) so FinLytics has time to validate.
3) David and Ben will sync with Samir and Priya to confirm whether configuration guidance or a short config patch is sufficient. If the fix requires a longer-term change we will surface a formal offer for Dedicated evaluation.

Samir — please confirm you accept the 100k interim top-up and we’ll process it this afternoon. Also sending through our MAA draft in case legal needs it signed to proceed with a longer Dedicated proof.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0198
Attachment: mutual-action-plan-v1.pdf

From: david_kim@redwood.ai <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, Samir Patel <samir@finlytics.io>
Cc: Priya Reddy <priya@finlytics.io>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 08:21:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot blocked by ingestion backpressure — need extra sandbox + 2-week extension

Ben / Marissa / Samir — I pulled the logs (thanks Samir) and did a quick pass. Summary:
- The retry storm amplified when multiple ingestion workers hit transient DNS timeouts and requeued identical batches. Backpressure came from concurrent KV cache writes in the connector path, not core generation tokens.
- Short-term mitigation: reduce parallelism from 12 -> 4 and add jittered backoff on retries. That should lower instantaneous token consumption by ~60%.

I approve the one-time 100k token sandbox top-up now. Marissa — please ask Billing to apply the top-up against pilot DL-2026-089 and lock the pilot end date +14 days.

Samir — once you confirm the change to worker parallelism we can schedule a 30-min window to rerun the pipeline with monitoring on. I’m happy to join that call.

Logs referenced: ingest-logs.zip
Config snapshot: snapshot-config.json
